tts: Hi, I'm Yefry Núñez, a software and A I developer from the Dominican Republic.

say: Across the Dominican Republic and Latin America, sunlight is not the problem. Access is. Many households and small businesses are interested in solar energy, but they don't know where to start.
Which provider can I trust? What will it really cost? Will it work where I live, and within my budget? Without clear answers, it is hard to make a good decision.
That is the barrier I want to help address: making affordable, reliable renewable energy easier to access.
I have explored this challenge through B Energy, an initiative designed to help people identify suitable solar energy providers based on their needs and their location.
tts: I have explored this challenge through Bee Energy, an initiative designed to help people identify suitable solar energy providers based on their needs and their location.

say: I worked on a prototype that incorporates data from NASA POWER and geographic services, so every recommendation starts from the real conditions of each place.
tts: I worked on a prototype that incorporates data from NASA Power and geographic services, so every recommendation starts from the real conditions of each place.

say: You share where you are and what you need. The tool looks at the solar resource in that location, and helps you compare options that fit your situation.

My experience in climate innovation, entrepreneurship and technology has taught me that good ideas only matter when people can actually use them. It has strengthened my commitment to practical solutions for the energy transition.
Next, I want to keep developing accessible digital tools, collaborate with renewable energy stakeholders, and help communities make informed decisions about solar energy.
Especially for people and small businesses with limited resources or technical knowledge. They often have the most to gain from clean energy, and the least information to choose it.
My goal is simple: to make clean energy easier to understand, and easier to adopt. Thank you for watching.
